text:
ConocoPhillips rose 0.74% today to $137.20, continuing a strong five-day rally (+5% since August 26) driven by escalating geopolitical tensions in the Middle East. Iran retaliated against U.S. strikes with attacks on Gulf allies, and there are reports of tanker incidents near the Hormuz Strait—a critical chokepoint where over 17 million barrels of oil passed through on a single day this week. With Brent crude holding above $95 per barrel and U.S. oil at $91.48, supply concerns from potential disruptions in one of the world's most important shipping lanes are lifting the entire energy sector, benefiting major oil producers like ConocoPhillips.

The move also reflects broader momentum in oil stocks tied to production growth. A major competitor just announced a $7 billion expansion in Venezuela that will double production there, signaling industry confidence in higher oil prices and renewed investment in supply. These geopolitical and production dynamics are creating a favorable environment for integrated oil companies with global portfolios.
